# Status checks that must pass before main accepts a merge.

# This file is the source. scripts/check_required_checks.py keeps it equal to
# the jobs in workflows/test.yml on every pull request; applying it to the
# branch ruleset is a manual step, because GITHUB_TOKEN cannot read or write
# repository rules. Editing this file therefore protects nothing on its own --
# see CONTRIBUTING.md for the command that pushes it to GitHub, and run the
# verify command afterwards.
